scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:extension && npm run build:api
scripts.build:firefox: npm run build:extension && node scripts/build-firefox.mjs && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs dist-firefox
scripts.test:production: npm run build:extension && node scripts/validate-extension.mjs dist
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.package:chrome: npm run test:production && node scripts/package-extension.mjs dist chrome
